title: Retitling Allowance for Kept Total-Loss Vehicles by State, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**State schedule.** A customer who keeps a total-loss vehicle under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage receives a retitling allowance for the salvage title and inspection the kept vehicle needs. On a policy whose policy state is OH or IN, 75 is added to the kept-vehicle settlement; on a policy whose policy state is KY or WV, 40 is added to it; in any other state nothing is added.

The policy state is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record.

| Policy state | Retitling allowance added (USD) |
|---|---|
| OH | 75 |
| IN | 75 |
| KY | 40 |
| WV | 40 |
| VA (any other state) | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a kept-vehicle settlement on an IN policy carries an added 75.00; the same settlement on a VA policy carries none.
